compatibility.description: p.52 combination matrix row '4MXM80A' shows connectable indoor units (dots) across families: CTXA (15/20/25/35/42/50), CTXM-R (15/20/25/35/42/50), FTXM-R (15/20/25/35/42/50/60/71), FTXJ (20/25/35/42/50), FTXP-M9 (20/25/35), FDXM-F9 (25/35/50/60), CVXM-A (35/50/60), FVXM-A (20/25/35), FVXM-F (25/35/50), FCAG-B (35/50/60), FFA-A9 (25/35/50/60), FHA-A9 (35/50/60), FNA-A9 (25/35/50/60). NOTE: matrix dots = CONNECTABILITY eligibility, NOT thermal pairing/rating (p.52 has NO efficiency table). Blurb: 'Jusqu'à 5 unités intérieures peuvent être connectées à 1 unité extérieure multi'.

evidence.locator: PDF p.52, combination matrix row '4MXM80A' (dot columns across UNITÉS INTÉRIEURES CONNECTABLES)
